title: Vibrant Japanese Fruit Mix Parfait
description: A sweet and refreshing Japanese dessert featuring a mix of seasonal fruits and glassy jelly, perfect for warm weather.

ingredients.name: Mixed seasonal fruits
ingredients.notes: such as strawberries, blueberries, and kiwi

instructions: Rinse the dried Kanten jelly in cold water, then soak it in water for 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked jelly, then cut it into small pieces.
Combine the jelly pieces and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the jelly is dissolved.
Add the sugar to the saucepan and stir until it is fully dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool to room temperature.
Once the jelly mixture has cooled, refrigerate it until it is chilled and set.
Cut the mixed seasonal fruits into bite-sized pieces and set them aside.
To assemble the parfait, layer the jelly, fruits, and coconut milk in a glass or bowl.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and matcha powder on top of the parfait.
Place the parfait in an ice bath to chill and set for at least 30 minutes.
